text:
I grow a white rose

in July as in January,

for the faithful friend

who offers me an open hand.


And for the cruel one who tears out

the heart by which I live,

I grow neither thistle nor nettle;

I grow the white rose.

translation.title: I Grow a White Rose…
translation.editorial_note: The plain diction and repeated final gift are preserved; franca becomes open, carrying candor and generosity.
